name: 53216 · Milwaukee, WI
findings: ZIP 53216 (Milwaukee) has 164 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 40 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53216 (Milwaukee) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 42 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
